<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תשרי_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518914033_theRebbe_108" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_A9_D7_A8_D7_99_meluket__BH_POST_1766518914033_theRebbe_108__p004">
  <section v="9">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Another explanation of "Return O Israel until Hashem your G-d" is that teshuvah must be until Hashem is only a level of Elokim and tzimtzum relative to the Ein Sof that is above Hashem.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">9)</t>
    <t s="1">And another explanation of "Return O Israel until Hashem your G-d,"</t>
    <t s="2">that the teshuvah must be until Hashem is only a level of Elokim and tzimtzum relative to the Ein Sof that is above Hashem.</t>
    <t s="3">And the difference between the two explanations is,</t>
    <t s="4">that according to the explanation of "until Hashem your G-d" that Hashem will be your G-d, your power and vitality,</t>
    <t s="5">what is drawn in revelation is the names Hashem and Elokim, except that the connection of the two names is through a drawing from the Ein Sof that is above Hashem and Elokim.</t>
    <t s="6">And according to the explanation of "until Hashem your G-d" that Hashem will be only a level of Elokim and tzimtzum relative to the Ein Sof that is above Hashem,</t>
    <t s="7">the light itself</t>
    <t s="8">(which is above Hashem)</t>
    <t s="9">is drawn in revelation.</t>
    <t s="10">For this, that Hashem becomes a level of Elokim and tzimtzum relative to the Ein Sof that is above Hashem, is specifically when this light shines in revelation.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="10">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The difference between the two explanations is analogous to the difference between the shofar blast and the recitation of the Shofarot verses.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="1">that the difference between the two explanations is analogous to the difference between the shofar blast and the recitation of the Shofarot verses.</t>
    <t s="2">For it is explained in the Hemshech of 5666,</t>
    <t s="3">that Malchuyot and Zichronot are in the light that fills and the light that surrounds,</t>
    <t s="4">and the drawing through the shofar is from the Ein Sof that is above the filling and surrounding,</t>
    <t s="5">and up to the drawing from the concealment of the Essence,</t>
    <t s="6">that through this drawing the unification of the surrounding and filling is effected.</t>
    <t s="7">And the drawing</t>
    <t s="8">through the recitation of the Shofarot verses is higher even than the drawing through the shofar blast.</t>
    <t s="9">For the drawing through the shofar blast is only the surrounding light and the filling light,</t>
    <t s="10">except that because the drawing is from the Ein Sof</t>
    <t s="11">[and higher than the concealment of the Essence],</t>
    <t s="12">they become connected and unified.</t>
    <t s="13">And through the recitation of the Shofarot verses, the concealment of the Essence itself is drawn,</t>
    <t s="14">in the manner of the revelation that will be in the future.</t>
    <t s="15">And this is</t>
    <t s="16">what in the Shofarot verses they recite the Shofarot verses of the Giving of the Torah and conclude with the matter of the shofar of the future,</t>
    <t s="17">for in the future there will be the revelation of the concealment of the Essence.</t>
    <t s="18">And likewise was the revelation at the Giving of the Torah.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="11">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The shofar of the future is superior to the shofar of the Giving of the Torah, and through the service of Rosh Hashanah the aspect of "He will blow a great shofar" is drawn.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">8)</t>
    <t s="1">And behold, the shofar of the future is more elevated than the shofar of the Giving of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="2">as it is brought in Pirkei d'Rabbi Eliezer</t>
    <t s="3">regarding the two horns of the ram of Yitzchak,</t>
    <t s="4">that the right horn is larger than the left,</t>
    <t s="5">for with the left He blew at Mount Sinai and with the right He will blow in the future to come.</t>
    <t s="6">And also in the shofar of the future itself there are several levels,</t>
    <t s="7">"And Ad-noy Elokim will blow a shofar,"</t>
    <t s="8">"and He will blow a great shofar."</t>
    <t s="9">For "Ad-noy Elokim" are names,</t>
    <t s="10">except that these names</t>
    <t s="11">(Ad-noy Elokim with the vowelization of Elokim)</t>
    <t s="12">are most elevated,</t>
    <t s="13">as explained at length in Likkutei Torah.</t>
    <t s="14">For this revelation will be at the beginning of the redemption.</t>
    <t s="15">And afterwards "He will blow a great shofar,"</t>
    <t s="16">"He will blow" without specifying who is the blower,</t>
    <t s="17">for this blowing is a drawing and revelation from the aspect of the Concealment of all Concealments.</t>
    <t s="18">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="19">that this, that in the Shofarot verses of Rosh Hashanah they also recite the verse "He will blow a great shofar,"</t>
    <t s="20">is,</t>
    <t s="21">because through the service of Rosh Hashanah they also draw this matter.</t>
    <t s="22">And based on this it can be said,</t>
    <t s="23">that this, that they say in the haftarah of Shabbat Shuvah "Return O Israel until Hashem your G-d,"</t>
    <t s="24">that in this Hashem is also included the matter of "Hashem Ad-noy" with the vowelization of Elokim, which is a most elevated level,</t>
    <t s="25">and nevertheless they say that teshuvah must be until Hashem is only a level of Elokim and tzimtzum relative to the Ein Sof that is above Hashem,</t>
    <t s="26">because through the service of Rosh Hashanah they also draw the matter of "He will blow a great shofar,"</t>
    <t s="27">and relative to this level,</t>
    <t s="28">even the name Hashem Ad-noy is considered like Elokim.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
